Overall, we considered 54 matrix multiplication sizes in our experiments. These were chosen roughly representing sizes ⟨𝑚, 𝑛, 𝑝⟩ where 2 ≤ 𝑚, 𝑛 ≤ 5, with some reasonable cutoff for 𝑝. Anecdotally, we encountered some difficulty when increasing the problem size: when we run the discovered programs on sizes beyond ⟨5,5,5⟩ on 1000 random seeds on evaluators with a single GPU accelerator, we often run out of memory.
